question: Which district has more pupils per school in 2025/26, Kelmarsh or Redfen, and by how many pupils per school?

samples.text:
Facts used:
- Kelmarsh has 11 schools and 3,268 pupils in 2025/26. [NR-04]
- Redfen has 10 schools and 3,147 pupils in 2025/26. [NR-09]

Calculation:
- Kelmarsh: 3,268 ÷ 11 = 297.091 pupils per school.
- Redfen: 3,147 ÷ 10 = 314.700 pupils per school.
- Difference: 314.700 − 297.091 = 17.609 pupils per school.

Redfen has more pupils per school by 17.609 pupils per school.

ANSWER: Redfen | 17.609
